about: Saskatoon is Saskatchewan’s largest city, on the South Saskatchewan River in the prairie parkland. Bridges, a university, and a compact downtown along the riverbank define its layout. It is a service centre for agriculture, potash, and a growing research sector. About 270,000 people live in Saskatoon.
